## What p measures: a shuffle demonstration {#shuffle data-hold="true"}

```{=html}
<div class="pm" id="pm">
  <div class="sm-controls">
    <div class="sm-mode pm-mode" role="group" aria-label="Shuffle">
      <button type="button" data-a="one">Shuffle once</button>
      <button type="button" data-a="many">Shuffle 1000 times</button>
      <button type="button" data-a="reset">Start again</button>
    </div>
  </div>
  <svg id="pm-plot" viewBox="0 0 1160 380" role="img" aria-label="Daily means before and after, and the differences after shuffling the labels"></svg>
  <p class="sm-readout" id="pm-out" aria-live="polite"></p>
</div>
<script>
(function () {
  const root = document.getElementById('pm'); if (!root) return;
  root.addEventListener('click', (e) => e.stopPropagation());
  // Real daily mean benzene, 15 July to 11 August 2004 (UCI Air Quality). Lab 06, Demo A: change on 29 July.
  const D = {"before":[12.55,12.4,8.62,6.05,12.13,13.98,12.97,14.89,13.23,7.27,3.65,7.86,7.09,11.1],"after":[11.3,12.12,9.23,5.81,9.24,10.15,8.5,7.62,10.47,6.63,4.96,8.13,8.9,7.12],"diff":-1.69,"p":0.131};
  const all = D.before.concat(D.after), OBS = D.diff, W = 1160, H = 380;
  let sims = [], last = null;
  const mean = (v) => v.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / v.length;
  function shuffleDiff() { const x = all.slice(); for (let i = x.length - 1; i > 0; i--) { const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1)); [x[i], x[j]] = [x[j], x[i]]; } return { d: mean(x.slice(14)) - mean(x.slice(0, 14)), lab: x }; }
  function draw() {
    let g = '';
    // top: the 28 days, coloured by the label they carry now
    const L = 70, R = 20, top = 30, h1 = 125, X = (k) => L + (k + 0.5) / 28 * (W - L - R), V = (v) => top + (1 - v / 16) * h1;
    const labels = last ? last.lab : all;
    g += `<text x="${L}" y="${top - 12}" font-size="16" fill="#66727C">${last ? 'after one shuffle: the same 28 values, labels mixed' : 'the 28 daily means, as measured'}</text>`;
    g += `<line x1="${L}" x2="${W - R}" y1="${V(0)}" y2="${V(0)}" stroke="#333F4A" stroke-width="1.5"/><line x1="${X(13.5)}" x2="${X(13.5)}" y1="${top}" y2="${V(0)}" stroke="#333F4A" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/>`;
    [0, 5, 10, 15].forEach((v) => { g += `<text x="${L - 10}" y="${V(v) + 5}" text-anchor="end" font-size="15" fill="#333F4A">${v}</text>`; });
    labels.forEach((v, k) => { g += `<rect x="${X(k) - 12}" y="${V(v)}" width="24" height="${V(0) - V(v)}" fill="${k < 14 ? '#0F6E6B' : '#E29A2D'}"/>`; });
    g += `<text x="${X(6.5)}" y="${V(0) + 22}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="16" fill="#0F6E6B" font-weight="600">"before"</text><text x="${X(20.5)}" y="${V(0) + 22}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="16" fill="#9a5f10" font-weight="600">"after"</text>`;
    // bottom: histogram of shuffled differences
    const b0 = 215, b1 = 340, lo = -5, hi = 5, bw = 0.5, nb = 20, XB = (v) => L + (v - lo) / (hi - lo) * (W - L - R);
    const counts = new Array(nb).fill(0); sims.forEach((d) => { const b = Math.floor((d - lo) / bw); if (b >= 0 && b < nb) counts[b]++; });
    const cmax = Math.max(5, ...counts), VB = (c) => b1 - c / cmax * (b1 - b0);
    counts.forEach((c, b) => { if (!c) return; const mid = lo + (b + 0.5) * bw; g += `<rect x="${XB(lo + b * bw) + 1}" y="${VB(c)}" width="${XB(lo + bw) - XB(lo) - 2}" height="${b1 - VB(c)}" fill="${Math.abs(mid) >= Math.abs(OBS) ? '#E29A2D' : '#B9C1C6'}"/>`; });
    g += `<line x1="${L}" x2="${W - R}" y1="${b1}" y2="${b1}" stroke="#333F4A" stroke-width="1.5"/>`;
    for (let v = -4; v <= 4; v += 2) g += `<text x="${XB(v)}" y="${b1 + 22}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="15" fill="#333F4A">${String(v).replace('-', '−')}</text>`;
    g += `<text x="${(L + W - R) / 2}" y="${H - 4}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="15" fill="#66727C">"after" minus "before", µg/m³ (bar height: number of shuffles)</text>`;
    for (const v of [OBS, -OBS]) g += `<line x1="${XB(v)}" x2="${XB(v)}" y1="${b0 - 10}" y2="${b1}" stroke="${v === OBS ? '#1C242B' : '#66727C'}" stroke-width="${v === OBS ? 2.5 : 1.5}" stroke-dasharray="6 4"/>`;
    g += `<text x="${XB(OBS) - 6}" y="${b0 - 14}" text-anchor="end" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#1C242B">measured −1.69</text>`;
    if (last) g += `<circle cx="${XB(Math.max(lo, Math.min(hi, last.d)))}" cy="${b0 - 4}" r="7" fill="#E29A2D" stroke="#1C242B"/>`;
    document.getElementById('pm-plot').innerHTML = g;
    const far = sims.filter((d) => Math.abs(d) >= Math.abs(OBS) - 1e-9).length;
    document.getElementById('pm-out').textContent = sims.length === 0
      ? 'If the change did nothing, the labels "before" and "after" are arbitrary. Shuffle them and see what differences chance alone gives.'
      : `${sims.length} ${sims.length === 1 ? 'shuffle' : 'shuffles'}. ${far} gave a difference at least as large as 1.69 in size: ${(100 * far / sims.length).toFixed(1)} %. Welch\'s t-test on these daily means gives p = ${D.p}.`;
  }
  root.querySelectorAll('[data-a]').forEach((b) => b.addEventListener('click', () => {
    const a = b.dataset.a;
    if (a === 'reset') { sims = []; last = null; }
    else { const n = a === 'one' ? 1 : 1000; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { last = shuffleDiff(); sims.push(last.d); } }
    draw();
  }));
  draw();
})();
</script>
```

[The shuffle shows what p means; it is not how the lab computes p. Lab 06 and your reports use Welch's t-test, which gets the same kind of share from a formula: here p = 0.13, close to the shuffle.]{.note-line}

[Lab 06, Demo A: benzene, 15 July to 11 August 2004, change on 29 July. Data: De Vito, UCI Air Quality, doi:10.24432/C59K5F, CC BY 4.0.]{.source}

## Reading p {#reading-p}

::: {.checks3}
::: {.c4}
[What it is]{.label}
If nothing had changed, the share of comparisons that would show a difference at least this large. In Lab 06 it comes from Welch's t-test. Demo A: p = 0.13.
:::
::: {.c4}
[What it is not]{.label}
Not the probability that the change worked, and not the size of the change. p = 0.001 can belong to a difference too small to matter.
:::
::: {.c4}
[What it assumes]{.label}
That the values are independent and that "nothing changed" is the only alternative. Session 12 tests both on plant data.
:::
:::

[0.05 is a convention, not a law. Report the p you got, not only which side of 0.05 it fell on.]{.note-line}

## Activity 1 · Significant, or important? {#act1 .activity data-hold="true"}

[Pairs · 10 minutes · no computer needed]{.act-label}

```{=html}
<div class="stories" id="sig">
  <div class="story"><p>Yield rose from 91.2 to 91.3 %, p = 0.0004, over 40 000 batches.</p><button type="button">Reveal</button><p class="ans" hidden><b>Significant, not important:</b> 0.1 point is real but may not pay for the change. Ask for the size in money.</p></div>
  <div class="story"><p>Energy use fell by 8 %, p = 0.20, over six weeks.</p><button type="button">Reveal</button><p class="ans" hidden><b>Not shown, not disproved.</b> The interval is wide: it includes zero and a large saving. Collect more weeks.</p></div>
  <div class="story"><p>"p = 0.03, so there is a 97 % chance the new catalyst works."</p><button type="button">Reveal</button><p class="ans" hidden><b>Wrong reading.</b> p is computed assuming no change. It is not the probability of either hypothesis.</p></div>
  <div class="story"><p>Twenty tags were compared before and after a shutdown. One gave p = 0.04.</p><button type="button">Reveal</button><p class="ans" hidden><b>Expected by chance:</b> one in twenty tests falls below 0.05 when nothing changed.</p></div>
  <div class="story"><p>Off-spec rate before 4.1 %, after 2.9 %; 95 % confidence interval of the change −2.0 to −0.4 points.</p><button type="button">Reveal</button><p class="ans" hidden><b>Useful report:</b> size and interval. The interval excludes zero, so p &lt; 0.05 without saying it.</p></div>
  <div class="story"><p>Benzene: 1.7 µg/m³ lower after the change, p = 0.13 on daily means.</p><button type="button">Reveal</button><p class="ans" hidden><b>Not shown.</b> Shuffled labels give a difference this large about one time in eight.</p></div>
</div>
<script>
(function () {
  const root = document.getElementById('sig'); if (!root) return;
  root.addEventListener('click', (e) => e.stopPropagation());
  root.querySelectorAll('.story button').forEach((b) => b.addEventListener('click', () => { b.hidden = true; b.nextElementSibling.hidden = false; }));
})();
</script>
```

::: {.prompt .small}
For each result: is the change shown, is it large enough to matter, and is the sentence a correct reading of p?
:::

## Size, interval, p {#report}

::: {.beforeafter}
::: {}
[Report this]{.label}
The difference with its unit, a 95 % confidence interval, the number of independent values, and p from Welch's t-test (it does not assume equal spread before and after). Demo A: −1.7 µg/m³ (−3.9 to 0.5), 14 + 14 days, p = 0.13.
:::
::: {}
[Then say]{.label}
What the interval allows: "a fall of up to 3.9 or a rise of up to 0.5 µg/m³ fits these data". And what else changed in the same weeks.
:::
:::

[The interval carries more than p: its width shows how much the data can tell, and its position shows the size.]{.note-line}
